example.title: Two-storey corner-lot apartment block with carports
example.place: Santa Monica, Los Angeles County, CA

brief: A c. 1970 two-storey corner apartment building: grey-green stucco, long flat balconies with slim rails, open carports under the upper floor, a pine on the corner. One photo. Scaled to the lot. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
